groups.description: Byte to vector embedding. Frozen in Phase 4 (no rule updates it yet).
Recurrent cell parameters (selected: gru, see model/specs/architecture.json); slow weights.

W_FAST (tensor memory.fast): short-lived associative matrix over sparse pattern-separated keys, written by a normalized delta rule with per-write decay; not persistent belief, never answers semantic queries.

W_MEMORY semantic keys: memory.semantic.keys (one unit-norm pooled key per slot, for the attention read) and memory.semantic.key_words (per-word vectors, for late-interaction verification). Produced by the frozen memory encoder at write time; zero when empty or erased.
W_MEMORY semantic values (memory.semantic.values): each value as rows of the frozen byte embedding, NUL-terminated; read by attention and decoded by nearest-embedding cleanup.

Frozen W_CORE memory encoders: core.memory_encoder (seeded random-feature embedding bag over hashed byte trigrams) and core.fast_separator (seeded projection for the k-winners-take-all W_FAST key). Verified byte-identical on every checkpoint load.
W_MEMORY metadata tensors (memory.semantic.meta, memory.state): status, confidence, logical creation/update time, source, provenance hash, supersession links, contradiction count; event clock.
Episodic ring (memory.episodic.keys, memory.episodic.meta): one record per memory operation (what happened), separate from semantic beliefs; key vectors are erased on forget.
Frozen vector-symbolic constants (core.reasoner.*): role phasors (subj, rel, obj, quant, scope), relation atoms, and the fractional-power number base. Seeded; verified bit-identical on load.

Phase 6 relational memory (memory.relations.*): one bound role-filler bundle per stated fact or rule, its polarity/confidence/provenance metadata, and the codebook of symbol vectors seen. Written only from user statements; derived answers are never written back.

Next-byte readout (readout.weight, readout.bias) over [GRU hidden ; last-byte embedding]. Starts at zero (uniform prediction); updated online by the delta or Hebbian rule with constants from model/specs/online-learning.json.

W_PROG: compiled circuit constants (tensors prog.<circuit>.<name>), produced by the zerolm-wsp compiler from model/prog/ specs with pinned hashes; verified bit-identical to the compiler output on every checkpoint load. Changed only by validated WSP patches (apply/revert, crates/zerolm-wsp/src/patch.rs); no circuit declares adaptable blocks yet.
Skill-level weight edits, accepted only via validated patches.
